title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater, Portchester NY on 1971-02-23

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy Feb 23 1971 Capitol show, featuring smoking Morning Dew, breakthrough Wharf Rat and breakneck Johnny B. Goode.
ai_review.review: The February ’71 Capitol run is praised for its tight, dirty quartet feel and an electric set that includes standout renditions of Morning Dew, The Other One, Wharf Rat/Greatest Story Ever Told and a blistering Johnny B. Goode.  Reviewers note the soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though the mix takes a moment to settle and the rhythm section sits prominently in the front.  Overall the performance is described as one of the most memorable and exciting evenings of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: All 11 reviews are 4‑5 stars with consistent praise for both musical performance and sound quality, yielding a strong average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear as a bell on most of the show; rhythm section (Bill & Phil) sits prominently.  Mix settles after a few minutes, and Jerry's guitar is slightly back in the mix but still audible.  Minor pedal looseness noted on drums.

standout_songs: Wharf Rat / Greatest Story Ever Told
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set is described as tight and dirty with smooth transitions; reviewers lament track‑splitting in the digital files but praise the overall flow of the performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar not front‑most in the mix but solid; leads breakneck Johnny B. Goode run.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass sits high in the mix and is praised for tight, powerful playing throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Loose bass‑drum pedal noted on some sections; overall drum work solid.
